entries.zh: 衷情；内心的情意、真挚的情感
entries.en: affection of the heart; heartfelt feeling

entries.zh: 志向；心之所向，过度偏爱而纵情
entries.en: inclination, aspiration; excessive fondness, being carried away by one's passion
entries.notes: 西语「过度偏爱、纵情」与 H「志向」义域不完全重合，取「心志所向」为桥梁义；M chì hiăng 支持「志向」读法。
M 栏「cor.」疑为缩写或旁注，不改变「剃」义。

entries.en: to shave off hair (with a razor)
entries.notes: H 第三字「檨」（芒果）与「剃毛」义不合，疑为原稿借字或形近讹字，未据以改读。

entries.zh: 抹油；以油涂抹、润泽（发肤）
entries.en: to anoint with oil; to smear with oil
for a woman to powder her face; to apply face powder
to cut or trim with scissors

entries.zh: 修面修眉；妆饰面容与眉毛
entries.en: to adorn or trim the face and eyebrows
entries.notes: H「作狀」与西语「修面修眉」不合；M chò chòng、R chō choāng 近「作粧（妆）」，疑原稿本作「粧」而未据改。

entries.en: for a woman to adorn herself; fine makeup
for a woman to comb her hair and put on makeup

entries.zh: 红颜；女子精心妆饰，容颜娇美
entries.en: for a woman to adorn herself carefully; a fair, beautified complexion

entries.zh: 纸人；孱弱无男子气概的人、娘娘腔
entries.en: effeminate man; a “paper man”, weak and unmanly

entries.zh: 系恋；对某物倾心、产生喜好
entries.en: to become attached to or fond of something

entries.zh: 系恋；沉溺于不贞、淫欲之事
entries.en: to become attached to unchastity; to be addicted to lewdness

entries.zh: 引动；打动、诱发（情感、兴趣）
忝亲；因婚姻而结成的亲戚、姻亲
entries.notes: H「忝」当为闽南语 tiam 的音借字（义同「沾」，谓沾连成亲），非「忝辱」本义。

entries.zh: 忝附是亲；因婚姻相连而成亲属
entries.en: to be attached into kinship by marriage; affinal kin
